newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NAB eyes Advanta buy - paper.
newsitem.headline: NAB eyes Advanta buy - paper.

text.p: Australia's largest and most acquisitive bank, National Australia Bank Ltd, is examining U.S. credit card group Advanta Corp as a potential takeover target, The Australian Financial Review newspaper reported on Wednesday.
"U.S. analysts said NAB was one of several interested parties to obtain information documents on Advanta," the newspaper said.

Advanta, which recorded a surprise first quarter loss recently and was then downgraded by Standard and Poors, had asked investment banks "to explore strategic options and possible mergers," the Financial Review said.
"It is believed formal expressions of interest in Advanta are being taken now with a view to a sale later this year if other options do not emerge," the newspaper said.
One unnamed analyst told the newspaper an Advanta buy would make a lot of sense for NAB, which already owns a banking subsidiary in Michigan.
"It gives them the credit card exposure they are after, it's a neat fit and it's a distressed operation -- the classic NAB scenario," the analyst said.
